author: Steve Kuckuk
text: It can (may) take over 24 hours (24 - 48) for the sensor to 'settle in' (reduce inflammation from needle inserting the sendor's filament) and give stabile readings . . . 'For me', I put the new sensor on my skin a full day ahead of needing it and then activate the new sensor a day later when the old one expires . . . The 14/15 days of usefulness counter will not begin until activation . . .
